name: Product Review Sentiment
description: 1,200 synthetic e-commerce product reviews (electronics, home, kitchen, apparel, books, beauty, toys, outdoor gear), 300 each labeled positive, negative, neutral or mixed, including sarcasm, negation and trivial-caveat hard cases.
task: What is the overall sentiment of this product review?

labels.name: positive
labels.description: The review is clearly favorable overall: it praises the product and contains no substantive complaint about it. Negated criticism ('not bad at all', 'can't complain', 'no complaints') counts as praise. A trivial caveat that the reviewer downplays and that concerns only shipping, delivery or outer packaging (e.g. 'the box arrived a little crushed') keeps the review positive; any complaint about the product itself makes it mixed instead.

labels.name: negative
labels.description: The review is clearly unfavorable overall: it reports defects, failures, poor quality or disappointment, including sarcastic 'praise' that actually describes a failure ('Great, it broke on day two.'). A token compliment that the reviewer dismisses or that concerns only shipping or packaging ('the packaging was nice, I'll give it that') does not make it mixed.

labels.name: neutral
labels.description: The review expresses no clear praise or complaint about the product: it states facts (features, specs, size, contents, delivery dates, who it was bought for) and/or gives an explicitly indifferent verdict ('it's fine', 'nothing special', 'not great, not terrible', 'too early to tell'). As soon as the reviewer explicitly judges an aspect of the product as good or bad, the review is not neutral.

labels.name: mixed
labels.description: The review contains at least one explicit, substantive praise and at least one explicit, substantive complaint about the product itself (function, quality, comfort, durability, value), given comparable weight, with no overall verdict that clearly settles on one side. A complaint about how the product performs counts as substantive even when framed as 'my only complaint' or 'would be five stars if not for'; a complaint limited to shipping or packaging does not.
